items.text: The shared setup creates isolated host/device state and runs fresh enrollment. The demo inventory catches remaining live bridge connections using legacy or cleartext setup. Exercise the migrated suites through their normal wrappers. `cmd:scripts/demo/check-tls-demos.sh` **new**

Run the real bridge round trip, attachment transfer, failover and revocation using the common TLS setup. `cmd:scripts/demo/round-trip.sh`, `cmd:scripts/demo/attachments.sh`, `cmd:scripts/demo/reconnect.sh`, `cmd:scripts/demo/revoke.sh`
